locations.note: A near 1:1 recreation of revolutionary Paris where Arno Dorian seeks redemption during the Terror.
Arno's childhood home at the royal court, where the story opens in 1776.
Notre-Dame, rebuilt stone by stone for the game, is climbed inside and out.
Arno infiltrates the Tuileries Palace, which the real city later lost to fire.
Arno is imprisoned in the Bastille and escapes as the crowd storms it in July 1789.
Dead Kings: in revolutionary Franciade, Arno goes down into the royal crypt beneath the Basilica of Saint-Denis.

routes.name: Arno Dorian
routes.note: Framed for his guardian's murder at Versailles, Arno escapes the falling Bastille, runs into Napoleon at the Tuileries, sinks into drink back in Versailles, returns to Terror-torn Paris to end Germain, and grieves Élise in Franciade's royal crypt.
